dogecoin.text: The story of Litecoin & Dogecoin is a metaphor for our crypto space: resilience, innovation & decentralization can birth new legends from old shadows!
Dogecoin's rise was the catalyst 4 change, but he never abandoned his dad. Now they're more powerful together than they were alone!
Resilience breeds innovation. The rise of Lester, born from the love of Litecoin and the spirit of Dogecoin, reminds us that even in darkness, a new dawn can emerge.
Litecoin vs Dogecoin - old guards vs new blood! It's not about who's better, it's about progress.
